Title: Twelve Essential Steps for Derailment Investigation  - Railway Track and Structures
# Twelve Essential Steps for Derailment Investigation. Wolf walks you through twelve essential steps for investigating derailments.**. You have only been a Roadmaster for 18 months and have never dealt with a major derailment. As you get in your truck to head to the scene, thoughts race in your head . This article will explore step by step the 12 action items required to make a good investigation for any member of the engineering team at a derailment site.
